pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark-toned regions with variable edge gradients; dorsal patches exhibit higher edge definition and more irregular, angular shapes, while lower flank patches show smoother, rounded transitions into the corridor network.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned inter-patch spaces forming a continuous topological graph. Node junctions are predominantly trivalent. Corridor width is non-uniform, exhibiting pixel expansion in the ventral-posterior quadrant of the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous dark mane along the dorsal midline. Silhouette displays a jagged 1D profile with low amplitude and high spatial frequency against the desaturated background.
